verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's core repo is explicitly AGPL-3.0 open source with the cloud version offering only 'additional features,' confirming the core product can be self-hosted, and community discussion corroborates its open-source/forkable nature. Missing for 10: first-party self-hosting setup docs (e.g. docker-compose instructions) and independent hands-on reports of successfully running a self-hosted instance.
